capabilities: make mdx files behave like markdown notes in the vault
disambiguation: It does not render or compile MDX (JSX) content; it only makes the files editable as Markdown.
extras: README is mostly generic installation and security boilerplate; version history only lists 0.0.1, suggesting the plugin is no longer actively developed, and it requires Obsidian 0.10.12 or newer.
problem: Obsidian treats .mdx files as unsupported, so users with MDX documents cannot read or edit them inside the vault.
summary: File-type plugin that lets Obsidian open and edit .mdx files as if they were Markdown notes.
